subject: Make the build of snowball stemmer use optimal compile flags (#826)
reason: The change only adds -O3 -flto to the compile flags of the vendored snowball stemmer in third_party/snowball/CMakeLists.txt. No source code, command behaviour, reply, index format, or config changes: it is a build/performance change with no intended behaviour change, so there is nothing for a scenario to mark as a changed reply and no behavioural path to drive. Per the rules, a build change with no behaviour change gets no scenario.
